description:
As a customer, I want to change my cart before checking out.

* Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
* Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
* Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
* Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

criteria.text: Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

cases.title: Increasing an item's quantity updates the line total and the cart total
cases.preconditions: A customer is logged in (or browsing as the story allows) with a cart containing <an item available for purchase> at quantity 1. The tester has noted the current line total and cart total.
steps: Open the shopping cart page.
Note the line total for <the item> and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of <the item> by 1.
cases.expected: The line total for that item is updated to reflect the new quantity, and the cart total is updated accordingly.

cases.title: Increasing quantity of one item in a multi-item cart updates only that line and the cart total
cases.preconditions: A cart contains <at least two different items>, each at quantity 1.
steps: Open the shopping cart page.
Note each line total and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of <the first item> by 1.
Check the line total of <the second item> and the cart total.
cases.expected: The first item's line total is updated for the new quantity and the cart total is updated; the other item's line is unchanged.

cases.title: Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total
cases.preconditions: A cart contains <at least two different items>.
steps: Open the shopping cart page.
Note the items listed and the cart total.
Remove <one of the items> from the cart.
cases.expected: The removed item no longer appears in the cart list, the remaining item(s) are still listed, and the cart total is updated to exclude the removed item.

cases.title: Removing the last item shows an empty cart message
cases.preconditions: A cart contains exactly one item: <an item available for purchase>.
steps: Open the shopping cart page.
Remove the only item from the cart.
cases.expected: The item is removed from the list, the total is updated, and an empty cart message is shown (exact wording not specified in the story).

cases.title: Cart contents persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: A cart contains <at least two different items> with known quantities.
steps: Open the shopping cart page and note the items, their quantities, the line totals and the cart total.
Refresh the page in the browser.
Compare the cart contents with what was noted.
cases.expected: The same items, quantities, line totals and cart total are shown after the refresh.

cases.title: Changes to the cart persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: A cart contains <at least two different items>, each at quantity 1.
steps: Open the shopping cart page.
Increase the quantity of <the first item> by 1.
Remove <the second item> from the cart.
Note the remaining items, quantities and the cart total.
Refresh the page in the browser.
cases.expected: After the refresh the cart still shows the increased quantity for the first item, the removed item is still absent, and the line total and cart total match the values noted before the refresh.
